_meta.source: Google Stitch export 'Game Simulator' (7 PNG screens: Beranda, Peristiwa dan Keputusan, Statistik pemerintahan, Laporan Hasil Kuartal, Profil presiden, Pengaturan permainan, Login). Export contained screenshots only (no HTML/CSS), so values are sampled from pixels, not read from code.
_meta.how_to_update: Edit values here; StitchTheme builds the Godot Theme from this file at startup. No Godot code change is needed for palette, outline, radius or depth changes.
_meta.font: Display font not identifiable from screenshots and not supplied. Put the licensed .ttf/.otf in res://assets/fonts/ and set fonts.display_path / fonts.body_path. Empty = Godot default.
